create_tool_insert_new_tool: create a new tool by inserting it into the database with user_id, form data, and specs
read_tool_get_tool_by_id: read a tool from the database by its unique id and return the tool model
list_tools_get_tools: list all tools from the database ordered by most recently updated with user information
